property_summary: For any two successful fallback calls with exactly 10 ether, if the second call's block timestamp equals the first call's block timestamp, the reference contract reverts on the second call (due to require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime)), while the buggy version allows it to succeed.
change_summary: Remove the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) statement so the pastBlockTime update and ether transfer can occur even within the same block timestamp.
